literal.prompt: Каким способом была принята Конституция России 1993 года?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The President's Library page states that the 1993 Russian Constitution was adopted by a nationwide vote on 12 December 1993 (core L47). The four answer labels now all name decision procedures; the Duma, Assembly, and Zemsky Sobor notes are individually grounded in their own retained official contexts.

literalGroups.literal: Конституция России 1993 года была принята всенародным голосованием. Голосование состоялось 12 декабря 1993 года.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The official President's Library page directly states the popular-vote method and the 12 December 1993 date.

literalGroups.literal: Государственная дума Российской империи начала работу в 1906 году.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The official page describes the Imperial State Duma's representative and legislative role and dates the first Duma's opening to 1906.

literalGroups.literal: Учредительное собрание России заседало в январе 1918 года и было распущено.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The archive record identifies a stenographic report of the Assembly session dated 5 January 1918; the official Library history page states that it was dispersed on 6 (19) January and the dissolution decree followed in the night of 7 (20) January.

literalGroups.literal: За Конституцию проголосовало около 58% участников референдума.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The official page says about 58 percent of referendum participants voted for the Constitution.

literalGroups.literal: Первый Земский собор традиционно датируют 1549 годом.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The official page states that the first Zemsky Sobor was convened in 1549 and calls it a representative estate body.
